nodes.description: Ownable._owner: address of the contract owner, controls onlyOwner-gated functions.
ERC20._balances: mapping of account balances updated by _transfer/_mint/_burn.
ERC20._allowances: nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount updated by _approve.
ERC20._totalSupply: total token supply mutated by _mint and _burn.
ERC20._name: token name 'XBURN.org' set once in the constructor.
ERC20._symbol: token symbol 'XBURN' set once in the constructor.
ERC20._decimals: token decimals, defaults to 18.
Private flag enabling the transfer fee logic in transfer/transferFrom.
Public transfer fee in basis points (123 = 1.23%), bounded to 2500 by setTransferFee.
Public address receiving collected transfer fees.
Public mapping marking accounts exempt from transfer fees (e.g. DEX pools).
xburn constructor: sets name/symbol and mints 7500e18 tokens to msg.sender.
onlyOwner function adding an account to the transfer-fee exception list.
onlyOwner function removing an account from the transfer-fee exception list.
onlyOwner function updating transferFee and toggling activeFee, capped at 25%.
onlyOwner function updating the feeRecipient address.
Overridden ERC20 transfer that deducts a fee when activeFee is set and sender is not exempt.
Overridden ERC20 transferFrom that charges a fee on the sender when the recipient is not exempt.
Internal ERC20 balance movement performing zero-address checks and balance updates.
Internal ERC20 allowance setter performing zero-address checks and emitting Approval.
Internal ERC20 supply increase assigning new tokens to an account.
Internal ERC20 supply decrease destroying tokens from an account.
onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0), permanently removing owner privileges.
onlyOwner function that transfers ownership to newOwner after a non-zero check.
View function returning the current _owner.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for sender identity, fee exemption and owner checks.
transfer(): uint256 fee = transferFee.mul(amount).div(10000) — unchecked-input arithmetic fee computation.
transferFrom(): uint256 fee = transferFee.mul(amount).div(10000) — unchecked-input arithmetic fee computation.
addFeeException(): feeException[account] = true — privileged state write.
removeFeeException(): feeException[account] = false — privileged state write.
setTransferFee(): transferFee = fee and activeFee toggle — privileged state write.
setTransferFeeRecipient(): feeRecipient = account — privileged state write.
renounceOwnership(): _owner = address(0) — irreversible privileged state write.
transferOwnership(): _owner = newOwner — privileged state write.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the token holder whose balance is debited and whose fee-exemption is checked inside transfer().
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is deducted in transferFrom().
msg.sender must equal _owner for the onlyOwner guard on addFeeException.
msg.sender must equal _owner for the onlyOwner guard on removeFeeException.
msg.sender must equal _owner for the onlyOwner guard on setTransferFee.
msg.sender must equal _owner for the onlyOwner guard on setTransferFeeRecipient.
msg.sender must equal _owner for the onlyOwner guard on renounceOwnership.
msg.sender must equal _owner for the onlyOwner guard on transferOwnership.
activeFee gates whether the fee branch executes in transfer().
feeException[_msgSender()] is read to decide whether a fee is charged in transfer().
transferFee is multiplied into the fee computation of transfer().
transferFee is multiplied into the fee computation of transferFrom().
feeException[recipient] is read to decide whether a fee is charged in transferFrom().
feeRecipient is the destination of the collected fee in transfer().
_balances is read and written by _transfer.
_allowances is written by _approve.
_totalSupply is increased by _mint.
_totalSupply is decreased by _burn.
transfer() calls the internal _transfer one or two times to move tokens.
transfer() executes the fee computation when activeFee is set and the sender is not exempt.
transferFrom() calls _transfer for the fee and for the principal amount.
transferFrom() executes the fee computation when activeFee is set and the recipient is not exempt.
transferFrom() calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
The xburn constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply for msg.sender.
setTransferFee performs the privileged write of transferFee/activeFee.
addFeeException performs the privileged write feeException[account] = true.
removeFeeException performs the privileged write feeException[account] = false.
setTransferFeeRecipient performs the privileged write feeRecipient = account.
renounceOwnership performs the irreversible privileged write _owner = address(0).
transferOwnership performs the privileged write _owner = newOwner.
